verdict.rationale: Bland documents a first-party analytics capability that can be queried through its official MCP server. It also offers LLM-judge evals that measure call quality, and keeps call logs of historical calls. None of the evidence describes a visual analytics dashboard or the specific metrics the story names. Missing for 10: documented analytics dashboards, success-rate metrics, call-duration metrics, outcome breakdowns, sentiment analysis, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
